# Flask → DuckDB `/api/v1` payload spec

Query param `?database=` is universal. Seasons on the wire may be `YY-YY`; routes normalize to `YY/YY`.

---

## TEAM

### `GET /team/get_teams`
- **Returns:** `string[]` distinct team names (`computed_data=false` player rows).
- **Service:** `get_all_teams` — `app/services/team_service.py` L129–144. Route ignores league/season filters today (`team_routes.py` L36–39).
- **Hook:** `useTeams` → `string[]`.

### `GET /team/get_available_seasons?team_name=`
- **Returns:** `string[]` seasons for that team (`Server.get_seasons`). L146–148.
- **Hook:** `useTeamSeasons`.

### `GET /team/get_team_history?team_name=`
- **Returns:** `{ [season]: { league_name, final_position, league_level, statistics } }` L220–232.
- **statistics keys:** `total_score`, `total_points`, `average_score`, `games_played`, `best_score`, `worst_score` (from `TeamStatistics.season_summary`).
- **league_level:** `get_league_level(league_name)` via `league_mapping.csv` (`app/utils/league_utils.py` L120+). First league per season only.

### `GET /team/get_league_comparison?team_name=`
- **Returns:** `{ [season]: { league_name, league_averages, team_performance, performance_rank, vs_league_average } }` L268–274.
- **league_averages** (input rows, `computed_data=false`, `input_data=true`) L312–318:  
  `average_score` = `mean_scores(score)` L301; `average_points` = mean points L302; `std_score`/`std_points`; `num_teams`; `total_games` = row count.
- **team_performance** L394–403: team means L370–371; `vs_league_score` = team − league L375; z-scores L380–381; `performance_rank` = final league position (not z-rank); `vs_league_average` = `vs_league_score`.

### `GET /team/get_clutch_analysis?team_name=&season=&clutch_threshold=10`
- **Clutch =** match with `|score − opponent_score| < threshold` (default 10). Strict `<`, not `≤`. L507–512.
- **Payload** L542–549: `total_games`, `total_clutch_games`, `total_clutch_wins` (margin > 0), `total_clutch_losses` (margin < 0), `clutch_percentage` = wins/clutch×100 L540, `opponent_clutch: { [opponent]: { wins, losses } }`.
- Season optional (`all`/omit → all seasons). If season set, league derived from history L140–145. **Does not** filter full-roster (unlike special matches).

### `GET /team/get_consistency_metrics?team_name=&season=`
- Scores from computed team rows (season path) or `get_matches` (all seasons). L567–616 / L621–655.
- **Formulas:** `mean` L627; population variance L628; `std` = √var L629; `CV%` = std/mean×100 L630; range/min/max; Q1/Q3 at `n//4` and `3n//4` L640–641; IQR.
- **consistency_rating** from CV L663–674: ≤5 Excellent, ≤10 Good, ≤15 Average, ≤20 Below Average, else Inconsistent.

### `GET /team/get_special_matches?team_name=&season=`
- Per-match rows only (`round_number > 0`), both sides full roster (`players_per_team` expected) L423–444. Skip missing scores.
- **Row keys** L455–464: `Season`, `League`, `Week`, `Round`, `Score`, `Opponent`, `OpponentScore`, `WinMargin` (= score − opp).
- **Buckets** (top 5 each) L468–480: `highest_scores`, `lowest_scores`, `biggest_win_margin` (margin > 0), `biggest_loss_margin` (margin < 0).

---

## PLAYER

### `GET /player/search?search=&club=`
- **Returns:** `{ id, name }[]` from player catalog. Substring match on name **or** id (case-insensitive) L738–745.
- Optional `club`: keep players with ≥1 game for that club L725–736. Empty `search` → full (filtered) catalog.
- **Hook:** `usePlayerSearch` — note FE currently only passes `club`, not live search text.

### `GET /player/get_lifetime_stats?player_name=&player_id=&season=all&club=`
- No player → aggregate all-players (`scope: "all"`) L97–99.
- **Player payload top keys:** `seasons[]`, `periods[]`, `lifetime{}` L1261–1326.
- **Row types in `seasons`:** `season_total` (`competition: "All Events"`) L1168–1191; `competition` (+ `club`, `history_club`, `team_name`, `team_number`, `rank`, `competitors`) L1227–1259.
- **Formulas (player):**  
  - season/comp: `total_pins = sum_scores_float(score)`, `average = pins/games` L1149–1151, L1215–1216  
  - `vs_last_season` = season avg − previous season avg L1157–1160  
  - league rank: mean score, `rank(method=min)` L1042–1059  
  - tournament rank: latest `Overall Cumulative Score` (else sum score) L1075–1141  
  - lifetime L1272–1325: same pin/avg; best/worst game; `best_season` = max season mean; `most_improved` = max `season_means.diff()`
- **`periods`:** week (league) / round (tournament) averages — L289–426.
- Aggregate adds `player_competitions`, `player_season_totals`, `scope: "all"`.

### `GET /player/get_available_seasons?player_name=&player_id=&club=`
- Sorted unique seasons from that player’s input rows; no player → all seasons (optional club games) L749–778.

### `GET /player/get_highest_individual_games?limit=10&player_name=&player_id=&season=all&club=`
- Top single-game scores, sort score desc then date desc L920–929. Limit clamped 1–100.
- **Row** (`_individual_game_record` L887–900): `player_name`, `player_id`, `score`, `date`, `season`, `competition`, `is_tournament`, `club`, `team_name`, `team_number`, `week`, `round_number`.

### `GET /player/get_club_300?club=`
- **300 =** perfect game `score == 300` L937. Newest first by date L940–942.
- Same columns as highest-games rows. Optional club filter on games-for-club.

---

## TOURNAMENT (extras beyond leaderboard + field_progress)

### Catalog
| Endpoint | Returns | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/tournament/get_available_seasons?tournament=&club=` | `string[]` | Distinct seasons L627–633 |
| `/tournament/get_available_tournaments?season=&club=` | `string[]` | Normalized **group** names L615–625 |
| `/tournament/get_available_players?season=&tournament=&round=` | `{id,name}[]` | Catalog or round-scoped L677–683, L649–675 |
| `/tournament/get_available_rounds` | `{round_number, round_name}[]` | L685–711 |

### `GET /tournament/get_tournament_format`
- **Rounds + handicap + KO config summary** (not bracket tree). L776–862.
- **handicap** L755–774: `used`, `columns.{handicap,apriori_average,handicap_reference}`, `pins` / `a_priori_average` / `handicap_reference` as `{kind:"uniform",value}` or `{kind:"range",min,max,mean}`.
- Also: `round_count`, enriched `rounds[]` (+ `is_ko_finale_cluster`), `ko_*` labels, `qualifying_cut_*`, `qualifying_stages`, public `config`, `config_note`.

### `GET /tournament/get_summary_cards?season=&tournament=&round=&n=5`
- `{ cards: [{ title, value, subtitle, type:"stat" }] }` L1096–1162.
- Always: Tournament, Current Round, Participants. Conditionally: Tournament Leader (avg_net ladder L1082–1090), Stage Winner (best set total scratch+hdc L3686–3709), Cut-Line (player at cut rank L3932+), Tournament Winner (KO final only — skip pin leaders when KO decided L1036–1148).

### `GET /tournament/get_round_results` → `TableData`
- Pivot: one row per stage×player; games as `game_{0-based}` (titles 1-based). Drop `KO_WO` club rows L1914–1915.
- **Single-round (grouped):** `#`=`overall_rank`, `player`, optional `handicap_display`/`club`, game cols, stage scratch/net (+ avgs), total scratch/net (+ avgs). Sort net or rank L2047–2188.
- **All-rounds (flat):** optional `round_name`, `player`, `club`, games, `handicap_per_game`, `total_scratch_handicap`, `round_total`, `avg_score`, `overall_total` L2211–2253.
- **avg_score** = round_total / played_games (>0) L1952–1953. Metadata heatmap 130–300 L2199–2207.

### `GET /tournament/get_player_section` (skip full KO internals)
- Keys L5529–5544: `player`, `player_club`, `player_card_layout`, `round_table` (TableData), `best_efforts`, `progress_series`, `field_progress` (public overlays), `summary`, `ko_bracket` (omit/empty for API v1 if desired).
- **summary:** `average` (last played avg), `best_position` + `best_position_game`, `final_position` (KO place if any else last chart pos) L5507–5541.
- **progress_series:** `avg_series`, `position_series`, `game_score_series`, `round_end_lines`, `labels` L2870–2940 / L5493–5497.
- **best_efforts:** `highest_game`, `highest_pair`, `highest_block`, `handicap_profile` L2544–2622.

### `GET /tournament/get_tournament_podiums?season=&tournament=&club=&n=3`
- `{ top_n, podiums: [{ season, tournament, tournament_group, finishers[{rank,rank_label,player,club,average}], tournament_average }] }` L5673–5702. Finishers from total leaderboard (KO-integrated when applicable) L5583–5671.

### `GET /tournament/get_player_tournament_results?player=&season=&tournament=`
- `[{ season, tournament, tournament_group, position, average, club }]` L5776–5784. Position prefers KO place; average = last progress avg L5759–5765. Sorted season/tournament desc.
